name: DEHUMIDIFIER
desc: Industrial-Grade Refrigeration Cycle Dehumidifier engineered for high-capacity moisture removal in laboratories and cleanrooms. Features a 50 Liters per day extraction capacity, driven by a hermetically sealed CFC-Free compressor and a digital humidity controller.
principle: The INNOLAB INSTRUMENTS DEHUMIDIFIER operates on a hermetically sealed refrigeration condensation cycle, utilizing a CFC-free eco-friendly refrigerant to extract moisture from ambient air. In this process, humid air is drawn across high-efficiency copper tubes with aluminium fins, where the refrigerant evaporates and cools the coil surface below the dew point, causing water vapor to condense into liquid droplets that collect in a high-volume storage tank or drain via a continuous port. The integrated digital humidity indicator-cum-controller with PID logic precisely maintains relative humidity between 40% and 80% RH, making it indispensable for laboratories, cleanrooms, and pharmaceutical storage. Doctors and researchers rely on this unit to protect moisture-sensitive reagents such as anhydrous salts, strong acids like hydrochloric and sulfuric acid, and volatile organic compounds (VOCs) from hydrolysis or degradation. B.Sc and M.Sc students use it to stabilize biological assays, cell cultures, and enzyme preparations, while PhD researchers employ it to prevent corrosion of analytical instruments and maintain ISO 14644 cleanroom standards. The automatic defrost function and washable pre-filter ensure continuous operation even in low-temperature environments, and the 24-hour timer allows scheduled dehumidification for ASTM E104-compliant humidity conditioning of materials testing chambers.
sop: Place the dehumidifier on a level surface with at least 30 cm clearance from walls and ensure the continuous drainage port is connected if unattended operation is required.
Plug the unit into a 220-240 V AC, 50 Hz single-phase grounded outlet and switch on the main power button.
Press the 'SET' button once on the digital humidity controller to enter target humidity setting mode.
Use the 'UP' and 'DOWN' arrows to adjust the required relative humidity value (e.g., 50% RH) as displayed on the LCD screen.
Press 'SET' again to lock the target humidity value; the controller will now maintain the chamber at this setpoint automatically.
If using the timer function, press the timer button and set the desired operating duration using the same UP/DOWN arrows, then confirm with SET.
Monitor the live display for present humidity, fan speed, and any error codes; the compressor will cycle on/off to maintain the setpoint.
Check the water tank level indicator regularly; when the full tank warning signal activates, the unit will auto-stop—empty the tank or ensure the drainage hose is unobstructed.
For continuous operation, connect a hose to the drainage port and route it to a floor drain, ensuring the hose is not kinked or elevated above the port.
Clean the washable pre-filter weekly by removing it, rinsing with water or blowing with compressed air, and allowing it to dry completely before reinserting.
At the end of daily use, switch off the main power button and unplug the unit if not in continuous mode; leave the tank empty and the door/vent open to prevent mold growth.

Safety Warning: Never operate the dehumidifier with a damaged power cord or in the presence of flammable vapors, and always disconnect from power before cleaning or servicing to prevent electric shock or fire hazard.
